'''''Colletia''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s belonging to the [[Rhamnaceae]] [[Family (taxonomy)|family]], with five species of spiny [[shrub]]s. All [[species]] of this genus are native to southern South America. They are [[non-legume nitrogen fixer]]s.
